findings.title: Ezicinin tüketerek işlemesi
findings.claim: The focus Crusher also admits an exploratory image of consuming what is placed before it, so the destination acts as a force that takes in accumulated stock without preserving its distinctions.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 104:4:4:2 carries root_000337/B008's voracious-consumption facet; 89:19 independently depicts inherited wealth being eaten indiscriminately, and that contact turns breaking into an intake-and-processing image.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader gains a distinct picture of the Crusher as something that consumes a stock, not only something that strikes it.
findings.containment: This is an uncandidate exploratory activation of an available focus branch. It does not make B008 the primary sense, literalize a digestive organ, or absorb the separate fragmentation and enclosure findings.

epistemic.reason: The branch and exact focus occurrence are supplied, while the independent 89:19 connection has no trust label or target morphology; the activation is therefore visible but exploratory.

branch_activations.boundary: Only the voracious-consumption facet is activated; the related grinding-organ and fire-comparison facets remain unclaimed.
